insights.title: Your heart is being watched during HER2 therapy
insights.found: Echocardiogram on 20 Sep 2026: LVEF 58%, against 62% before HER2 therapy (a 4-point fall); global longitudinal strain -19%. NT-proBNP 85 pg/mL (lab limit <125).
insights.why: You have taken trastuzumab and pertuzumab every 3 weeks since 1 Dec 2025, to complete one year.
insights.means: Your pumping function is within normal limits; the report notes the 4-point fall from baseline. Your heart-strain marker is in range.
insights.do: Keep the heart checks your oncology team schedules.
insights.expected: Your team sees any change early.

insights.title: Your haemoglobin is slightly below the usual range for women
insights.why: It is below 12.0, the fifth centile of healthy non-pregnant women in our rule's source.
insights.means: A population boundary, not a decision point. Your oncology team will read it with your treatment history.
insights.do: Ask whether iron studies are needed.
insights.expected: A cause, if there is one.

insights.title: Your fingertip tingling is recorded as grade 1
insights.found: Grade 1 chemotherapy-related nerve tingling in your fingertips, and mild tiredness. Docetaxel and carboplatin stopped on 20 Mar 2026.
insights.why: Our biomarker stage lists standard neuropathy assessment tools and fall risk as checks for this.
insights.means: Grade 1 is the mildest grade. Tracking it shows whether it is settling.
insights.do: Rate it in your check-in and mention any change.
insights.expected: A record your team can use.

insights.title: Heart-risk models could not run without cholesterol
insights.found: Seven heart and diabetes risk models were attempted; none could compute.
insights.why: Total cholesterol and HDL are missing, and some models also need your region or waist.
insights.means: We never estimate from missing values.
insights.do: Add a cholesterol panel to your next blood test.

insights.title: Your germline test report is not in your record
insights.found: Your maternal aunt had breast cancer at 48. Your clinic reports a multigene hereditary cancer panel as negative, but the report was not supplied.
insights.why: Our biomarker stage lists hereditary-risk assessment given the family history.
insights.means: With the report on file, your twin can show exactly which genes were tested.
insights.do: Ask your clinic for a copy of the germline report.

ask.q: Is my heart OK on trastuzumab?

ask.q: How long will I be on HER2 therapy?
ask.a: Your record says trastuzumab and pertuzumab started on 1 Dec 2025, to complete one year. Your oncology team confirms the end date.

ask.q: Will the tingling in my fingers go away?

It was 11.8 g/dL, slightly below the usual range for women. The run cannot tell why; iron studies are the next step.
It is a blood marker reported with breast cancer care. Yours was 22 U/mL, inside the lab's range of under 30. No rule in our library reads it.

glossary: Haemoglobin
The protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen.
ALT
Alanine aminotransferase: a liver enzyme measured in blood.
eGFR
Estimated glomerular filtration rate: how well your kidneys filter, calculated from creatinine, age and sex.
BMI
Body mass index: weight divided by height squared.
HbA1c
Average blood sugar over about the last 2-3 months.
Rule
One of our clinical checks. Each has a source, a threshold and an evidence grade; it fires only when your result clears it.
HER2
A growth-signal protein. HER2-positive cancers respond to HER2-targeted medicines such as trastuzumab.
LVEF
Left ventricular ejection fraction: the share of blood the heart pumps out with each beat.
Complete response (pCR)
No invasive cancer left in the breast or nodes at surgery after treatment.
NT-proBNP
A blood marker of heart strain.
CIPN
Chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy: nerve tingling or numbness after chemotherapy.
